marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 失孤 | Shi gu = LOST AND LOVE

Based on a true story, "Lost and love" strives to represent the trauma that human trafficking brings to individuals and families. In 1998, Lei Zekuan (Andy Lau) lost his son and has been searching for him ever since. Along the way he encounters a motorcycle repairman named Zeng Shuai (Jing Boran) who was trafficked at the age of 4. Two lost souls go hand in hand to search for their long lost families, developing a special father-son relationship.
